fields.label: Test checkpoint
fields.options: Development test only. All punches skip auto attendance. Offline claims require HR review. Face verification is not yet enabled.

fields.label: Test Employee
fields.description: Choose only your dedicated Mobile Test employee. This login must use the custom punch API.

fields.label: Require GPS Workplace Check for Test Punches
fields.description: Enable only after configuring an enabled Mobile Attendance Workplace for the test employee's company. Both IN and OUT require a fresh precise location.

fields.label: Require Approved Device for Test Punches
Enable Offline Test Claims
fields.description: Approved devices only. Upload within 24 hours; HR must review before a test checkin is created.

fields.label: Require Punch Photo and GPS
fields.description: Record the time when the punch button is pressed, then take a photo and capture GPS. Photos are private evidence; no identity or liveness verification is performed.
